boundaries: Original ARM instructions perform profile packing, mixed-radix packing, checksum and digit output.
Host hooks replace allocation/free and the DS hardware divider only; the text banks are written directly instead of running CODEC_INIT.
The panel drawing, strategy editor and registered-team save writers are not replayed; this web build supplies the fresh-team defaults.
